title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #1 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Where does the River Ganga begin? (1 mark)
   A. In the Himalaya mountains
   B. In the Rift Valley
   C. At the Indian Ocean coast
   D. In Lake Victoria

2. Which is a good way to collect free water for the home? (1 mark)
   A. Buying bottled water only
   B. Collecting rainwater from a roof
   C. Digging a hole in the road
   D. Taking water from a neighbour

3. The Beas river is linked with which region of India? (1 mark)
   A. Kerala
   B. Punjab
   C. Gujarat
   D. Bengal

4. Which is a role of trees and plants? (1 mark)
   A. They make the sun set
   B. They give oxygen and shade
   C. They stop rain forever
   D. They dry up rivers

5. Why can children with special needs join the tree planting activity? (1 mark)
   A. They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   B. Only adults can plant
   C. They must not be included
   D. They are too weak

6. Which of these is a use of water at home? (1 mark)
   A. Cooking food
   B. Producing sunlight
   C. Making the wind blow
   D. Making rocks

7. Who was Prahlad? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A Jain monk
   C. A Sikh Guru
   D. The young son of Hiranyakashipu who loved Vishnu

8. A snake is often shown with statues of which Tirthankar? (1 mark)
   A. Buddha
   B. Narsimha
   C. Guru Ram Das
   D. Parshvanath

9. Whom did Guru Ram Das Ji serve before becoming Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   B. Guru Amar Das Ji
   C. Guru Arjan Dev Ji
   D. Guru Nanak

10. Where is Lumbini today? (1 mark)
   A. In Uganda
   B. In Punjab
   C. In Kenya
   D. In Nepal

11. What are the Laavan? (1 mark)
   A. Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   B. Prayers before meals
   C. Festival songs of Maha Shivratri
   D. Yoga postures

12. Which Enlightened Being is a Sikh Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Narsimha
   B. Parshvanath
   C. Lord Buddha
   D. Sri Guru Ram Das Ji

13. What do all four Enlightened Beings in the lesson teach in common? (1 mark)
   A. Anger
   B. Kindness, truth and service
   C. Selfishness
   D. Pride

14. What do the words nar and simha mean in Narsimha? (1 mark)
   A. King and queen
   B. Man and lion
   C. Water and fire
   D. Sun and moon

15. What is an Avtar? (1 mark)
   A. A form in which God is believed to come to earth
   B. A holy river
   C. A daily prayer
   D. A kind of tree

16. Which scripture is a Jain book about the life of Lord Mahavir? (1 mark)
   A. Ramayan
   B. Guru Granth Sahib
   C. Kalpasutra
   D. Dhammapada

17. What is Ayodhya Kaand about? (1 mark)
   A. Yoga
   B. The life of Guru Nanak
   C. The birth of the Buddha
   D. Ram going to the forest and Bharat's humility

18. Who went into the forest with Ram? (1 mark)
   A. Bharat and Shatrughna
   B. Sita and Lakshman
   C. Vishwamitra
   D. Kaikeyi

19. According to the Dhammapada teachings in the lesson, hatred is ended by what? (1 mark)
   A. Silence
   B. Fighting
   C. More hatred
   D. Love

20. Which is a main message of Jain scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Take revenge
   B. Practise Ahimsa
   C. Practise pride
   D. Be greedy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe the lessons of the Uttaradhyayan Sutra. (4 marks)

22. How can you learn more about the scriptures? Give four ways. (4 marks)

23. Name two trees or plants that are sacred in different faiths. (2 marks)

24. Choose one scripture and explain how a child can apply its teaching at home and at school. (5 marks)

25. Explain how you would present a short skit on one Enlightened Being. (4 marks)

26. Explain why the River Rijubalika is important to Jains. (3 marks)

27. Explain how a maize farm uses all five elements. (4 marks)

28. State two reasons why trees and plants are important. (2 marks)

29. Why should we not bully others, according to the teachings in this lesson? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — In the Himalaya mountains
   The Ganga starts high in the Himalaya and flows across northern India.

2. B — Collecting rainwater from a roof
   Roof water can be stored in a tank or jerrican.

3. B — Punjab
   The Beas flows in Punjab, where Sikhism began.

4. B — They give oxygen and shade
   Plants clean the air and give shade.

5. A — They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

6. A — Cooking food
   We use water for cooking, drinking and washing.

7. D — The young son of Hiranyakashipu who loved Vishnu
   Prahlad stayed faithful to Vishnu.

8. D — Parshvanath
   The snake is a sign of Parshvanath.

9. B — Guru Amar Das Ji
   He served the third Guru with humility.

10. D — In Nepal
   Lumbini lies in Nepal.

11. A — Hymns sung at a Sikh wedding
   Guru Ram Das Ji wrote these wedding hymns.

12. D — Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
   He was the fourth Guru of the Sikhs.

13. B — Kindness, truth and service
   Their teachings are alike in these values.

14. B — Man and lion
   Nar means man and simha means lion.

15. A — A form in which God is believed to come to earth
   An Avtar is a coming down of God to protect goodness.

16. C — Kalpasutra
   The Kalpasutra tells the life of Lord Mahavir.

17. D — Ram going to the forest and Bharat's humility
   It tells of Ram's fourteen years away from the kingdom.

18. B — Sita and Lakshman
   Sita and Lakshman chose to go with him.

19. D — Love
   Hatred is not ended by hatred but by love.

20. B — Practise Ahimsa
   Ahimsa is central in Jainism.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Practise Ahimsa, be honest, control greed and anger, and respect teachers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Listen to a resource person, visit a temple or library, discuss with friends, watch a documentary, use a safe search engine with an adult (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tulsi, Ber (Beri) tree, Bodhi tree, Sal tree (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plant.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct scripture with a clear lesson and two examples, for example Ramayan: keep promises at home by helping with chores and at school by returning a book on time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for scripture, 1 mark for lesson, 1 mark each for home and school examples, 1 mark for clarity.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a story, decide the characters, practise the lines, act it out, and then say what lesson it teaches.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for choosing the story, roles, practice, acting and lesson (any four).

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains believe Lord Mahavir became fully enlightened while sitting on its bank, so the river is honoured in Jainism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Jain link, 1 mark for Lord Mahavir, 1 mark for enlightenment.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: The soil is Prithvi, rain and river water are Jal, the sun's heat is Agni, the wind that carries pollen is Vayu, and the open sky is Akash.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each element linked correctly to the farm, up to 4.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give oxygen, shade, food and medicine; their leaves are used in worship (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Enlightened Beings teach kindness and Ahimsa, so we should not harm others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness or Ahimsa, 1 mark for a link to bullying.
